principal_investigator.name: Nutth Tuchinda
principal_investigator.bio: Nutth is an assistant professor in the CME department at NJIT (starting Fall 2025). He grew up in Bangkok, Thailand, and received a BEng in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering from Chulalongkorn University under the thesis supervision of Prof. Chedtha Puncreobutr and Prof. Boonrat Lohwongwatana. He completed his PhD with Prof. Chris Schuh at MIT (2019–2023), then worked as a postdoc in the Schuh and Olson groups at MIT before joining NJIT.

postdocs.name: Gabriel Alkuino
postdocs.bio: Gabriel is a postdoctoral researcher at NJIT/CIMSEPP, co-advised with Prof. Rajesh Davé. He works on modeling and simulation of pharmaceutical powders. He received his BS and MS in physics from the University of the Philippines Diliman and his PhD in physics from Syracuse University, where he worked with Prof. Teng Zhang on computational mechanics of magneto-active soft materials. Outside of research, he enjoys walking aimlessly, thrifting, cooking dishes from around the world, and collecting out-of-print textbooks he sometimes reads.

graduate_students.name: Md. Hasib
graduate_students.bio: BS in Mechanical Engineering (2025), Bangladesh University of Engineering & Technology (BUET). Enjoys walking, hiking, teaching, and solving math problems.

graduate_students.name: Fahmid Faiyaj Chowdhury
graduate_students.bio: Fahmid Faiyaj Chowdhury completed his B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET). He has taken an interest in the world of materials science and how his skills in computational tools and coding can be used for advancing materials research. In his free time, he likes to immerse himself in playing video games.

graduate_students.name: Abul Hassan Fatemi
graduate_students.bio: Abul is pursuing an MS in Artificial Intelligence at NJIT. He completed his B.Tech in Electronics and Instrumentation at SGSITS Indore, India. He enjoys working with large language models and is currently exploring agentic AI. Outside of research he likes swimming, cricket, watching movies, and travelling with friends.

undergraduate_students.name: Anna Julia Nunes Araujo
undergraduate_students.bio: Anna Julia Nunes Araujo is an undergraduate student at the New Jersey Institute of Technology majoring in Chemical Engineering. She is excited about the field of materials science and eager to advance her skills through active research. Outside of academia, she likes to immerse herself in reading and painting.

high_school_students.name: Could be you!
high_school_students.bio: High-school students interested in computational materials science are welcome to inquire about summer and short-term projects.

alumni.name: David Onyegbule
alumni.bio: David Onyegbule is an undergraduate student at New Jersey Institute of Technology majoring in Chemical Engineering. With a growing background in clean and renewable energy, he is driven to explore this academic path through research.

alumni.name: Thomas Stephen Amburan
alumni.bio: Thomas Stephen Amburan is a second-year undergraduate student studying Materials Science and Engineering at the University at Buffalo. He enjoys watching basketball and playing sports in his free time.

alumni.name: Tucker Erbeck
alumni.bio: Tucker is a visiting student who recently completed a B.S. in Chemical Engineering from the University of Southern California. He enjoys running, swimming, and working on 3D printing projects.

alumni.name: Avinoam Eiselt
alumni.role: High School Summer Intern 2026, Science Initiative Program
alumni.bio: Avinoam Eiselt is a rising senior at The Frisch School with interests in mechanical engineering and materials science. In his free time he enjoys building engineering projects, storm chasing, and rock climbing.

alumni.name: Maria Kalitseva
alumni.role: High School Summer Intern 2026, Partners in Science, Liberty Science Center
alumni.bio: Maria Kalitseva is a junior at Millburn High School, interested in chemical engineering and materials science. Outside of school, Maria enjoys skiing, drawing, baking, and taekwondo.
